note: THE FILENAME SLUG IS WRONG. This page is not Lunenburg central office and not a Lunenburg school roster at all: it is the opening of the Montachusett Regional Vocational Technical School (Monty Tech) section of the town report -- page 137 is the Monty Tech cover and 138 is Sheila Harrity's letter. The 'school' field is therefore set to 'monty-tech', which is outside the five values the schema lists, so that these six people cannot be silently folded into a Lunenburg staff count. The annual-report catalogue independently classifies pages 139-140 as 'Monty Tech member towns and enrollment by town', not as a roster. Lines 2-7 are the eighteen member towns printed in three columns (x=0.092, 0.320, 0.539) -- towns, not people -- and are ignored. Lines 14-19 are the leadership block, name-then-role separated by a comma, centred on the page as single-column lines. Line 9 states the leadership team 'is comprised of ten talented administrators'; six are named. Lines 22-33 are the prose and the stray labels of an enrollment bar chart. Line 34 is the printed page number 137.
